questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition.
Who are the key competitors to Hyne Pallets and Advance Pallets in NSW and do they competitively constrain Hyne Pallets and Advance Pallets?
Provide market share estimates for the for the supply of wooden pallets in NSW, in particular Hyne Pallets and Advance Pallets.
Who are the alternative timber suppliers, other than Hyne Pallets for the supply of timber to wooden pallet manufacturers in NSW?
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Hyne Pallets and/or Advance Pallets.
